name: Worldshepherd Assurance Selection Benchmark v1
purpose: Compare evidence-backed assurance depth for agent/control-plane systems without treating cloud scale, market share, model quality, price, or brand reach as part of this profile.
non_claims: This benchmark is not a universal product ranking.
A higher score does not establish that a system is better for every deployment, workload, customer, or procurement.
Missing public evidence is scored as not evidenced, not as proof that a competitor lacks a capability.
Vendor documentation is not treated as independent reproduction.
Worldshepherd-controlled CI is not treated as independent reproduction or external customer use.
Competition records must cite public evidence current enough to support the scored state.
A Worldshepherd-authored score lead is not public leadership evidence until the benchmark methodology has attributable external review.

criteria.name: Pre-action authorization and fail-closed policy
criteria.requirement: System can block or deny consequential/tool actions before execution and has an explicit fail-closed/default-deny boundary.

criteria.name: Human authority boundary
criteria.requirement: System can require identified human review/approval for actions above a defined autonomy or authority boundary.

criteria.name: Rejected-input non-mutation
criteria.requirement: Malformed, oversized, or prohibited inputs are rejected without silently mutating protected state.

criteria.name: Tamper and corruption detection
criteria.requirement: Evidence/state corruption or unsafe substitution is detected and surfaced rather than silently accepted.

criteria.name: Replay, duplicate, and idempotency control
criteria.requirement: Repeated or replayed requests/events are explicitly detected, bounded, deduplicated, or made idempotent where side effects matter.

criteria.name: Recovery, readiness, and rollback evidence
criteria.requirement: System exposes recovery/readiness behavior and preserves evidence across restart, restore, rollback, or durable-resume cases.

criteria.name: Exact release identity and dependency/evidence manifest
criteria.requirement: An evaluator can bind results to an exact release/commit plus declared runtime/dependency/evidence identity.

criteria.name: Clean-room and sovereign verification portability
criteria.requirement: A bounded evaluation/verification path can execute in an evaluator-controlled or self-hosted environment without hidden dependence on the author's development machine.

criteria.name: Evaluator-controlled hidden challenges and discrepancy retention
criteria.requirement: Protocol reserves final challenge control and original discrepancy evidence to an outside evaluator and forbids deleting negative evidence.

criteria.name: Standards-portable telemetry and evidence
criteria.requirement: Evidence/telemetry can map to or interoperate with public standards or vendor-neutral schemas rather than remaining a product-only opaque record.

criteria.name: Claims, compliance, and maturity boundary
criteria.requirement: System/process explicitly distinguishes implementation, internal evidence, simulation, external validation, compliance/certification, and operational/customer claims.

criteria.name: Attributable independent reproduction
criteria.requirement: An evaluator outside the development process has reproduced the bounded behavior under outside-controlled conditions and retained attributable evidence.

criteria.name: Attributable external workflow use
criteria.requirement: A named external organization has used the bounded capability on a real workflow with measurable acceptance criteria and attributable evidence.

leadership_gate.wording_when_passed: Leads this benchmark profile under the recorded public evidence set as of the stated date.
prohibited_wording: independently validated unless A12 is evidenced
adopted or customer-proven unless A13 is evidenced
